metadata.title: That ONE kill no one saw coming (including me) - Valorant logic strikes again
metadata.description:
Wait, how did that even happen?
Me pretending my aim finally showed up.
Watch the accidental clutch of the century.
Only in Valorant, folks.

Click if you’ve ever lucked into a kill and acted like a pro!
